introHtml: White hand sanitizer offers a clean, professional look that fits seamlessly into any corporate environment. Whether you choose 1 oz squeeze bottles for desk-side use or credit card-shaped sprayers for easy pocket carry, white packaging keeps your logo front and center without visual clutter. It is a versatile choice for healthcare offices, schools, or any setting where a neutral, hygienic appearance matters. Decorate with pad printing or a full-color sleeve to match your brand colors.
